theorems.name: Submission.dorag_tes_gt_graph_measure_exceptional_set
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (ξ : Euclid (n + k)) (r a : ℝ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (P : Euclid (n + k) →L[ℝ] Euclid n) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k), W ⊆ U → 0 < r → closedBall ξ r ⊆ W → (∀ v, P (ι v) = v) → (∀ w, P (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v w, ‖f v - f w‖ ≤ ‖v - w‖) → (∀ v, ‖f v‖ ≤ r / 4) → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ closedBall ξ r → R.mult x = 1) → μHE[n] ((R.measure.support ∩ W) \ R.carrier) = 0 → μHE[n] ((range (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) \ R.measure.support) ∩ closedBall ξ r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a → R.measure ((fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2)) ≠ ∞ ∧ ∃ Z : Set (Euclid n), MeasurableSet Z ∧ μHE[n] ((fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' Z) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a ∧ ∀ h : Euclid (n + k) → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable h → ∫⁻ x in (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2), h x ∂R.measure = ∫⁻ x in (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) '' (ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 2) \ Z), h x ∂μHE[n]
